blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. will embark on a working visit to Singapore from Oct. 7 to 11 to expand economic engagement, deepen bilateral ties, and advance cooperation in sectors that can contribute to the country’s development. Marcos has also been personally invited by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong to attend the Formula 1 Grand Prix, Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Assistant Secretary Analyn Ratonel said in a statement on Tuesday.
